headline: Creates a special board to oversee Defense Department investigations into possible chemical and biological exposures during the 1991 Gulf War.
what_it_does: This order sets up a Special Oversight Board to watch over how the Department of Defense investigates chemical and biological incidents tied to the Gulf War. Based on the title, the board's role is oversight of those investigations. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the board, its specific powers, and how long it lasts are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The board oversees investigations into chemical and biological incidents they may have been exposed to during the war.
Its investigations of Gulf War chemical and biological incidents become subject to review by the new board.

when_it_takes_effect: 1998-02-19 (date signed; no separate effective date provided)
